$comment: LotRace absolute proportion scale. Rule: board = 1000, 1 unit = 0.1% of the board side. A street (property) is 83.33 wide x 125 deep. Piece sizes below are relative to the STREET, mapped to CSS container-query units (cqw/cqmin/cqh) because each .board-tile is a container. Percentages are (unit / street dimension).
$semantics: Buildings are the ASSET the player built and read biggest. The car is only a position marker and is the smallest movable object on a tile.

derivedCss.$comment: Piece height is % of street DEPTH (125); building/icon size is % of street WIDTH (83.33). cqmin ~= street width for tall-narrow tiles; use cqh for depth-based height.
